items.new_text: Each proposal in the proposed-decisions window shows its proposed line, the lead, the beat, the evidence pointer and every quote the lead gave as its own element, each quote beside the source it names.
A proposal whose evidence pointer cannot be read is shown with the label unknown source and is never hidden, and a quote is shown only as plain text, never interpreted as markup.
The proposed-decisions window can be used with the keyboard alone, and a screen reader hears each proposal as a labelled group with its quotes as a labelled list.
